requirement_text.REQ-154: RESTATEMENT OF LUA-08 AS ONE HALF OF A TWO-LAYER PAIR. Wire a CONFIGURABLE :max_instructions budget into REQ-153's executor path. Convert budget exhaustion into a structured error distinguishable from every other failure arm. Test the hazard directly using REQ-148's spike answer (a). GATE: SECURITY-REVIEWER is a hard gate. NOT IN THIS REQUIREMENT: the out-of-band host kill (REQ-155), memory limiting (REQ-156).

acceptance_criteria: the instruction budget is configurable (not a hardcoded literal) and a test drives two different configured budgets and asserts the smaller one halts a loop sooner
a test runs an unbounded `while true do end` loop under a configured budget and asserts the execution terminates rather than hanging
budget exhaustion surfaces as a structured error value distinguishable by pattern match from other failure arms
a test asserts what a script that pcalls its own budget exhaustion does, matching REQ-148's spike answer (a)
the moduledoc states that this requirement RESTATES LUA-08 as layer 1 of a two-layer pair, :max_instructions is in-band and pcall-catchable, REQ-155 supplies layer 2
the moduledoc states that R-Co's INV-2 and INV-4 do not port
mix test and mix compile --warnings-as-errors both pass with real output quoted

task.description: Gate the design artefact at lib/letflow/design/req154-lua-instruction-budget.md. Read it independently -- do not rely on CODE-DESIGNER's result.summary. For each acceptance criterion: (a) is there a concrete design element? (b) is the function signature fully specified with @spec? (c) is the error shape stated with enough detail for pattern-match tests? (d) are cross-module deps listed? (e) is there NO implementation code (.ex function bodies)? FAIL immediately on any check failure.
acceptance_criteria: Every AC from REQ-154 maps to a concrete design element (no 'TBD')
All public function signatures have @spec with full input/output types including all error arms
Budget-exhaustion error shape is stated as a concrete value distinguishable from other error arms
Cross-module dependencies listed (sandbox.ex update noted as a required companion change)
No .ex code blocks with function bodies present
ISS-0350 fix (is_binary guard and @impl restoration) is explicitly designed
